hints.title: Find the permitted heights
hints.body: Set t=2x, so t>0. Compare t with its denominator 1+t.
hints.recap: The fraction always lies strictly between 0 and 1.
hints.pitfall: A positive exponential numerator does not make the quotient unbounded.

recall.reminder: A real exponential with positive base always has positive output.

hints.title: Inspect the two ends
hints.body: As x becomes very negative, 2x approaches 0. As x becomes very positive, divide numerator and denominator by 2x.
hints.recap: End behaviour reveals the horizontal asymptotes.
hints.pitfall: A sketch’s unlabelled height is not a known numerical scale.
hints.pause: What does <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" display="inline"><mrow><mfrac><mrow><mn>1</mn></mrow><mrow><mn>1</mn><mo>+</mo><msup><mn>2</mn><mrow><mo>−</mo><mi>x</mi></mrow></msup></mrow></mfrac></mrow></math> approach at the positive end?

recall.reminder: An inner positive range can be passed through a reciprocal expression.

hints.title: Determine the direction of change
hints.body: Write <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" display="inline"><mrow><mi>y</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>1</mn><mo>−</mo><mn>1</mn><mo>/</mo><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mn>1</mn><mo>+</mo><msup><mn>2</mn><mi>x</mi></msup><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></math>. Track how the denominator, its reciprocal, and then the whole expression change as <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" display="inline"><mrow><mi>x</mi></mrow></math> increases.
hints.recap: Reciprocals reverse order for positive numbers.
hints.pitfall: The outer subtraction reverses the direction once more.
hints.pause: Combine the resulting direction with your endpoint limits and intercept to select the graph.

recall.reminder: Reciprocals reverse order for positive numbers.

solution:
Because 2x>0, the value 2x1+2x lies between 0 and 1 for every real x. At x=0 it equals 12.

As x→−∞, the numerator tends to 0 and the denominator tends to 1, so y→0. Rewriting y=11+2−x shows y→1 as x→∞.

Moreover y=1−11+2x increases with x. The rising bounded graph with those two limiting heights is A.
knowledgePattern: Identify a logistic graph through limits and monotonicity
